title: L.B. Foster at InnoTrans 2026: Building the Future of Mobility, Together
summary: From 22-25 September 2026, L.B. Foster proudly exhibited at InnoTrans 2026, the world's leading international trade fair for transport technology, held in Berlin. This year's event was especially significant as it celebrated the 30th anniversary of the exhibition, bringing together rail and mobility professionals from across the globe.
body_markdown:
Recognized as the hub of the global mobility industry, InnoTrans 2026 delivered another record-breaking event, attracting approximately 175,000 trade visitors from more than 120 countries and 3,190 exhibitors representing 59 countries.

As a long-standing participant at InnoTrans, L.B. Foster was delighted to welcome customers, partners, suppliers and industry colleagues to discuss the challenges and opportunities shaping the future of mobility. It was a pleasure to welcome Austin Bender, Ralf Schloesser and Julius Fuchs from FUCHS, and to discuss how our ongoing collaboration continues to deliver measurable value for rail operators worldwide while strengthening connections across the rail industry.


> "We are grateful to everyone who took the time to visit our stand, meet with our team of experts and explore how L.B. Foster can support their infrastructure goals," said Jason Bowlin, Senior Vice President - Rail "InnoTrans continues to be an invaluable opportunity to engage directly with customers and partners, understand industry priorities and demonstrate the innovation and expertise that L.B. Foster brings to the rail sector."


Tania Tacke, Sales Manager for L.B. Foster’s DACH region, delivered a presentation on the inform by L.B. Foster portfolio to approximately 40 representatives from Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg (VBB), the publicly owned transport authority responsible for coordinating one of Germany’s largest regional mobility networks.


The exhibition provided an excellent platform to strengthen existing relationships, establish new connections and exchange ideas with industry leaders driving the future of transport. Productive discussions throughout the week reinforced the importance of collaboration in delivering more efficient, resilient and sustainable railway networks.


The conversations and partnerships developed during the exhibition have already created exciting opportunities for future collaboration. Our experts look forward to continuing discussions with customers and industry stakeholders in the weeks ahead, exploring how L.B. Foster's solutions can help address evolving rail infrastructure requirements and deliver long-term value.


We would like to thank everyone who visited us during the event and helped make InnoTrans 2026 such a success. If you were unable to attend the show or did not have the opportunity to meet with our team, we would be pleased to discuss your requirements and explore how L.B. Foster can support your projects.


For more information, please contact us at **uksales@lbfoster.com** .
